messages:
jamie: Morning — quick async for release lane A. Planning a cut at 16:00 PT if smoke looks good. Current blockers: flaky e2e on canary, one cherry pending review (PR #842). Anyone available to help with the flake?

maria: I can try to reproduce the e2e flake, starting now. @leo please pause any new cherry-picks into A for the next 30m. :eyes:

leo: pausing cherries to A. PR #842 is mine — pushed an env-race fix, needs another review.

akash: reassigning review to @ashley. Also noticed a small latency blip in model-serving metrics at ~10:12, might be related to canary. @sre-oncall can you look at node pool?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for release-A at 2026-03-17T15:10:12Z — 2/3 hosts healthy.

sre-oncall: Checking node pool now. Seeing elevated CPU on pool-3; draining one host for investigation. Will post logs shortly.

ashley: review done on #842, left a comment about config var. If maria confirms the flake is test-harness infra, we can merge and roll forward. :thumbsup:

maria: reproduced the race locally, pushing a flaky-fix patch. Running e2e locally then will kick CI: `pytest tests/e2e/test_smoke.py -k race`

jamie: Plan: if e2e passes and canary stays healthy, target cut at 16:00 PT. If canary degrades we'll rollback and open a follow-up. @deploy-bot please hold the final cut until I ack.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Pause requested for release-A by @jamie. Canary will continue, final cut held until manual ack.

leo: heads-up — a backport landed to main last minute. I can cherry-pick to release-B instead to avoid touching A.

akash: I'll keep an eye on metrics. If p50 latency > 200ms for >3m I'll start rollback procedures.

sre-oncall: Log dump: https://redwood.internal/logs/abcd1234 — observed repeated `kv-cache OOM` on host-2, could explain the blip.

maria: CI e2e run queued, should finish in ~10m. Local run passed.

jamie: thanks everyone. If CI is green in 20m I'll signal the cut. If not, we'll bump to tomorrow morning.
